answer_correctness.method: Micro-average frozen required points, 0/1/2; incomplete transport output receives only partial diagnostic credit, never a passing case.

answer_completeness.method: Required points addressed, separate from correctness and completed service delivery.

fully_correct_points.method: Fraction of frozen required points fully correct; missing comparison point stays missing.

faithfulness.method: Inventoried factual claim occurrences; absence statements evaluated as abstention. Review includes the retained partial output.

answer_relevance.method: 0 off-topic, 1 extraneous, 2 responsive. Responsiveness does not establish completeness or service completion.

citation_support.method: Semantic support of associated claim/citation pairs, not ID validity.

citation_coverage.method: Factual claims with local supporting citations; claim-free abstentions and deterministic clarifications exempt.

appropriate_abstention.method: Unanswerable cases including unresolved scope; a transport-interrupted answer does not pass.

incorrect_abstention.reason: No applicable reviewed observations in this workload.

answerable_refusal.reason: No applicable reviewed observations in this workload.

strict_pass_rate.reason: No paid judge; use explicit Codex functional_case_pass_rate and source review.

contradicted_claims.reason: Support sufficiency reviewed; no independent contradiction taxonomy.

claim_count.method: All explicit reviewed factual claim occurrences.

first_delta_seconds.method: Successful observations; median P50, nearest-rank P95. Successful service observations only; includes deterministic clarifications when present, excludes HTTP/browser; queue/provider wait included.

total_seconds.method: Successful observations; median P50, nearest-rank P95. Successful service observations only; includes deterministic clarifications when present, excludes HTTP/browser; queue/provider wait included.

generation_seconds.method: Successful observations; median P50, nearest-rank P95.

generation_first_delta_seconds.method: Successful observations; median P50, nearest-rank P95.

retrieval_seconds.method: Successful observations; median P50, nearest-rank P95.

embedding_seconds.method: All executed successful query embeddings, including the subsequently failed generation; skipped calls are not timed zeros. Median P50, nearest-rank P95.

packing_seconds.method: Successful observations; median P50, nearest-rank P95.

search_fusion_seconds.reason: Production service exposes total retrieval, embedding, rerank and packing; search/fusion not independently timed.

reliability.method: All planned RAG requests; SDK retries disabled, partial answers do not succeed.

judge_reliability.reason: No paid judge; use explicit Codex functional_case_pass_rate and source review.

judge_seconds.reason: No paid judge; use explicit Codex functional_case_pass_rate and source review.

ingestion.reason: No calls for this stage; verified closed baseline index reused.

query_embedding.method: Provider-reported totals for 1/1 calls; missing failed-call usage excluded, not zero billed cost.

generation.method: Provider-reported totals for 1/1 calls; missing failed-call usage excluded, not zero billed cost.

judge.reason: No calls for this stage; verified closed baseline index reused.

cost.reason: Provider responses do not expose billed dollars; no inferred price substituted.

evidence_tokens.method: Exact formatted supplied evidence tokens including metadata.

concurrency_throughput.method: Sequential RAG batch including logging, excluding initialization, ingestion and judge; not load capacity. Monotonic interval is authoritative; wall-clock timestamps span a longer unexplained interval and are not substituted for measured service durations.

ingestion.reason: No fresh ingestion; source/index hashes and chunk snapshots verified against the baseline.

update_delete.reason: This live pass queries a copied index; lifecycle checks are separate offline records.

model_loading.reason: Local reranking disabled; no local inference model loaded.

personal_error_abstention.method: Personal/API-error unavailable facts, excluding document clarifications.

scope_clarification.reason: No applicable reviewed observations in this workload.

functional_case_pass_rate.method: Frozen strict required-point and source gates AND service completion; retain failures.

english_compliance.method: Manual full-output review, including retained partial answer.

named_source_compliance.method: Attribution against exact file identities; separate from omitted answer points.

original_rubric_correctness.method: Historical rubric retained separately; not the revised acceptance denominator.

attempt_duration_seconds.method: All attempts to terminal complete/error, including failure; this is not complete-answer latency. Median P50, nearest-rank P95.

failed_total_seconds.reason: No failed attempts in this recovery workload.

failed_first_delta_seconds.reason: No failed attempts in this recovery workload.

failed_generation_seconds.reason: No failed attempts in this recovery workload.

failed_generation_first_delta_seconds.reason: No failed attempts in this recovery workload.

missing_generation_usage.method: All generation calls have final reported usage.

points.reference: The saved guide does not specify the exact HTTP status code or JSON error body; do not invent either.

findings: Complete abstention on both exact HTTP status and JSON payload, with a supported extra support-status claim. Repeated absence statements are scored as abstention, not positive source claims. This recovery does not replace the failed attempt.

limitations: LLM judgments are assessments, not human ground truth; inventory misclassification and semantic errors remain possible.
In-process production streaming service, excluding app HTTP transport; no warmup, caches and host/provider load uncontrolled.
Single failed-case recovery, not a repeat of the full suite.
reviewer: Codex implementer, not independent human review
